candidate_value.domain_label: Analysis, registration and transparency
candidate_value.supporting_text: The public trial record prespecifies the three behavioral outcome families, PRE/POST timing and expected SPECTRA-specific improvement pattern, and the paper reports these outcomes plus non-significant companion subresults.
